strategyLegend.meaning: Favourite price has been highly reliable in the noted distance/sample.
Favourite price is reliable, but still check draw and race shape.
Mixed signal; use price with form, box/trap and distance.
Prefer shorter-priced runners with inside or favourable draw, not price alone.

tracks.name: Gosford
tracks.headline: Strong favourite-follow track at 515m.
tracks.rule: Follow the market more confidently at 515m; still downgrade poor draws when a close-priced inside runner exists.

distances.note: 47.5% noted as tempting, but smaller sample than 515m.

tracks.notes: One of the strongest large-sample AU favourite strike-rate tracks from the earlier analysis.

tracks.name: Angle Park
tracks.headline: Accurate favourites at 530m, but not necessarily blind-bet value.
tracks.rule: Use favourite price as a strong signal at 530m, but avoid treating strike-rate as profit.
tracks.notes: Earlier note changed from 'bad rate' to accurate favourite, but poor blind-bet value warning.

tracks.name: Darwin
tracks.headline: Very strong favourite-follow signal at 312m.
tracks.rule: Follow price strongly at 312m unless the race setup gives a clear reason not to.
tracks.notes: Kept as FOLLOW $ from the original guide.

tracks.name: Mandurah
tracks.headline: Good favourite-follow signal, strongest at 400m.
tracks.rule: Follow price at 400m; be more selective at longer distances.
tracks.notes: Kept as FOLLOW $ with distance warning.

tracks.name: Launceston
tracks.headline: Upgraded from bad-rate note; 278m favourites are reliable.
tracks.rule: Use favourite price as a strong signal at 278m.
tracks.notes: Earlier conversation explicitly upgraded Launceston.

tracks.name: Wentworth Park
tracks.headline: Distance-specific: strong at 520m, weak at 280m.
tracks.rule: Follow price at 520m; do not apply the same rule blindly at 280m.
tracks.notes: Keep the site warning prominent because the old broad 'great follow rate' note was too broad.

tracks.name: Sandown Park
tracks.headline: Reliable favourite signal at 595m.
tracks.rule: Follow price at 595m, with normal draw/form checks.
tracks.notes: Included from the AU ranking.

tracks.name: Cannington
tracks.headline: Decent favourite signal at 520m, stronger smaller sample at 600m.
tracks.rule: Use price plus form; do not treat as top-tier favourite-follow.
tracks.notes: Classified as B+ / check form.

tracks.name: Bendigo
tracks.headline: Box and distance matter; not pure favourite-follow.
tracks.rule: Use favourite price with box and distance. Box 1 is especially strong at 500m.

distances.note: Box 8 is competitive with inside boxes; do not overrule too hard.

tracks.notes: Added as B / BOX + DISTANCE in the prior conversation.

tracks.name: Warragul
tracks.headline: Favourite-follow is weak at 400m.
tracks.rule: Do not blindly follow the dollar at 400m; trap/form should carry more weight.

distances.note: 45.3%, but only 53 favourites; do not overrate it.

tracks.notes: Explicitly downgraded in the previous analysis.

tracks.name: Richmond (Loop)
tracks.headline: Loop/circle track only; Richmond Straight removed.
tracks.rule: Treat as Richmond's loop/circle track. Do not mix with the separate 324m straight course.
tracks.notes: User corrected the guide: it is not Richmond Straight, it is the loop.

tracks.notes: Original note: trap/form over dollar.

tracks.name: Sheffield
tracks.headline: Trap draw is a big factor; T5/T3 strongest for favourites.
tracks.rule: Do not use lower trap = better here. T5 and T3 were strongest in the 2026 favourite-by-trap numbers.

distances.note: Sequence start noted in the user's working sheet.

tracks.name: Newcastle
tracks.headline: Trap draw is moderate; T5/T3/T1 best for favourites.
tracks.rule: Use trap as a tie-breaker, but this is less extreme than Sheffield.

distances.note: Sequence noted in the user's working sheet.

tracks.name: Towcester
tracks.headline: Not a simple inside-bias track overall, but 500m opens had inside bias.
tracks.rule: For graded favourites, T4/T3/T5 performed best; for 500m opens, respect the inside bias.

distances.note: Earlier sample showed T1-T3 about 21.8-23.4% versus T4-T6 about 14.3-17.0%.

tracks.notes: Labelled TRAP-SPECIFIC / 500m INSIDE BIAS.

tracks.name: Hove
tracks.headline: T3 favourite draw strongest, while T1 is strong across all runners.
tracks.rule: Treat as trap-specific, not a blanket inside-draw track.
tracks.notes: Across all graded runners, T1 had strongest 2026 track-level win rate at 20.6%.

tracks.name: Harlow
tracks.headline: Distance matters; T4/T3 best for favourites.
tracks.rule: Check the distance before leaning on a trap rule.

distances.note: T6 had strongest overall trap strike rate at 22.5%.

tracks.notes: Favourite traps: T4 37.9%, T3 37.7%, T5 weakest at 29.1%.

tracks.name: The Valley
tracks.headline: Good favourite strike-rate; T2/T5 favourite draws strong.
tracks.rule: Prefer T2/T5 favourite setups; do not assume lowest trap is best.
tracks.notes: Across all graded runners, T6 had the highest overall trap win rate at 22.0%.

tracks.name: Star Pelaw
tracks.headline: Very strong favourite strike-rate; middle traps are strongest.
tracks.rule: Do not treat as inside-only. Middle traps, especially T4/T5, are strongest for favourites.
tracks.notes: Star Pelaw is the renamed Pelaw Grange.

tracks.name: Kinsley
tracks.headline: Weaker favourite track; T3 best, T6 weak.
tracks.rule: Be cautious following price alone; avoid overvaluing wide favourites.
tracks.notes: Added with Star Pelaw and Newcastle refresh.

tracks.name: Tralee

tracks.rule: Use market price plus inside/favourable draw. Needs Irish race-level favourite-by-trap calculation.
tracks.notes: Original working note: Trap draw = big factor.

tracks.rule: Next useful stat: when the favourite is wide, how often does a similarly priced inside dog beat it?
